beta.title: What is processed today, during the public beta
beta.reading: You read the information pages without an account: no personal data is asked of you.
beta.logs: The host (Vercel) keeps technical logs, including the IP address, for one day; rate limiting (Upstash) keeps a counter per IP address for a few minutes.
beta.browser: Your browser keeps a security cookie (<0>__csrf</0>) and, if you change them, your display settings.
beta.email: If you write to us at {{email}}, your message is received in our mailbox (Microsoft Outlook) and is used only to reply to you.
beta.closed: The following are not open: accounts, case files, messages, documents, appointments, assistant, audience measurement and error tracking (Sentry). The parts of this page that describe them will apply once they open.
clear.button: Delete my answers saved on this device
clear.done: Your answers have been deleted from this device.
mentions.title: Legal notice
mentions.seo.description: Legal information: publisher, hosting, responsibilities and contact for the AccesDirectAide website.
mentions.intro: Who publishes AccesDirectAide, who hosts it, where the information comes from.
mentions.publisher.title: 1. Publisher of the website
mentions.publisher.nature: A free service providing information on social rights and guidance on where to turn. It is not a government website. It is not published by the State, a local authority, the CAF or any other benefit-paying body.
mentions.publisher.statusNote: No association is yet registered in the register of associations of the tribunal judiciaire (court) of Strasbourg: the full identification of the publisher will be published after registration.
mentions.publisher.territory: Focused on Strasbourg and the Bas-Rhin.
mentions.host.title: 2. Hosting and data storage
mentions.host.intro: Here are the host and the service providers that store data for the service. Some are only planned for when the service goes live.
mentions.host.appLabel: Hosting of the application (website and server functions):
mentions.host.appBeta: in service for the public beta. The server functions run in Frankfurt; the public pages and files are distributed by Vercel's worldwide network, as close as possible to the visitor.
mentions.host.dbBeta: Neon, LLC (Databricks group; Databricks, Inc., 160 Spear Street, Suite 1300, San Francisco, CA 94105, United States) — database hosted in Frankfurt (European Union), subscribed through Vercel.
mentions.host.filesBeta: not used during the public beta (no document can be sent).
mentions.host.rateBeta: Upstash, Inc. — data hosted in Frankfurt (European Union), subscribed through Vercel; contact details: https://upstash.com.
mentions.host.errorsBeta: Sentry is not activated during the public beta.
mentions.host.mailBeta: Microsoft (Outlook), for the contact address published above: the messages received are used only to reply.
mentions.host.toComplete: [TO BE COMPLETED: chosen provider, address and telephone]
mentions.host.errorsToComplete: [TO BE COMPLETED: contracting entity, address and telephone]
mentions.host.transfers: Vercel Inc. and the publisher of Sentry are American companies. The place of storage and the transfer safeguards are described in the <0>privacy policy</0>.
mentions.content.title: 3. Content, sources and intellectual property
mentions.content.rights: The original texts, the layout and the visual identity of AccesDirectAide belong to <0/>, unless stated otherwise.
mentions.content.sources: The information on benefits comes from public sources (for example the information sheets of Service-Public.gouv.fr / DILA, reused under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Open Licence)) and from content written by the team. Each reuse states its source, its update date and a link. This reuse does not mean any endorsement by the public administration.
mentions.content.falc: The simplified texts (FALC — easy to read and understand) may be written automatically, by a model run by AccesDirectAide, from the official source. They are published only after an automatic check of their consistency with that source; the page states when a text has also been reviewed by a person. Each of them links to its official source.
mentions.liability.title: 4. Liability and limits
mentions.liability.indicative: The information on benefits, amounts, conditions and deadlines is given for guidance only. It may change. A simulation or guidance on AccesDirectAide is not a decision: only the competent body (CAF, MSA, CPAM, France Travail, Collectivité européenne d'Alsace, CCAS, etc.) decides whether a benefit is granted.
mentions.liability.assistant: The automatic assistant does not give legal advice. The publisher corrects reported errors as soon as possible and remains liable for its faults under the conditions provided for by law. Data security is described in the <0>privacy policy</0>.
mentions.contact.title: 5. Contact us
mentions.contact.legal: For a legal question, a copyright matter, to report illegal content or an error, or about our terms of use: contact@accesdirectaide.fr or the contact form.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What data we process, why, for how long, and your rights.
privacy.summary.title: In brief
privacy.summary.minimum: We process only the data needed for the service. We do not sell it and we do not advertise.
privacy.summary.noAccount: You can read the information pages without an account.
privacy.summary.sharing: You choose which organisation you share your case file with, and you can stop sharing whenever you want.
privacy.summary.encryption: Exchanges with the website are encrypted in transit (HTTPS). Your messages, notes and documents, the answers in your shared case files and the name and notes of an appointment are also encrypted when they are stored. This is not end-to-end encryption: our servers hold the keys. Your email address and the telephone number of an appointment are not encrypted when stored: they are used to recognise you and to contact you. Administrators have no access to the content of case files; emergency access is limited, recorded and reviewed by another administrator.
privacy.summary.assistant: The assistant is a computer program (AI), not a person. It does not decide on your rights.
privacy.summary.rights: You can download your data, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, and complain to the CNIL (the French data protection authority).
privacy.controller.title: Who is responsible for your data?
privacy.controller.label: Data controller:
privacy.controller.noDpo: We have not appointed a data protection officer to date.
privacy.controller.structures: The organisations (CCAS, associations, professionals) that use AccesDirectAide are responsible for what they do with the information you share with them and for their follow-up notes.
privacy.data.title: Data processed and why
privacy.data.reading.title: 1. Reading the website without an account
privacy.data.reading.noAccount: You can read the information pages without an account.
privacy.data.reading.beta: During the public beta, we do not measure the audience and we do not record errors with a service provider; the host keeps its technical logs (including the IP address) for one day, and rate limiting keeps a counter per IP address for a few minutes.
privacy.data.reading.noAudience: We do not measure the audience; we record technical errors.
privacy.data.reading.audience: We measure the audience for our own use only (pages viewed, main actions) and we record technical errors.
privacy.data.reading.securityLogs: The security logs contain the IP address; they are kept for 365 days.
privacy.data.questionnaire.title: 2. The questionnaire
privacy.data.questionnaire.text: Your answers are sent to our server for the calculation, without being kept there. Your device keeps them for 24 hours, then deletes them on your next visit; on a shared device, delete them straight away. If you share your case file with an organisation, an encrypted copy of your answers is kept for this sharing.
privacy.data.account.title: 3. Your account
privacy.data.account.text: Sensitive content (messages, notes, documents, shared answers) is encrypted when stored (no end-to-end encryption). Your account is kept as long as you use it. Automatic deletion of inactive accounts is not yet in place.
privacy.assistant.title: The information assistant (AI)
privacy.assistant.what: The assistant is a computer program (artificial intelligence), not a person. It runs on our servers: your questions are not sent to any outside AI provider. It answers only on the basis of verified information pages, cites its sources and does not answer if it finds no reliable answer. It does not decide on your rights.
privacy.assistant.retention: Conversations and quality measurements are kept for 90 days.
privacy.assistant.never: Never give it your social security number, or any health or banking data.
privacy.measurement.title: Audience measurement and technical errors
privacy.measurement.vercel: Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights (Vercel Inc., an American company): pages viewed, main actions and display speed, for our own account only. We do not send the text of your searches. Legal basis: legitimate interest; you can object to it by writing to us.
privacy.measurement.vercelOff: This measurement is not activated: no data is sent to Vercel Web Analytics or to Speed Insights.
privacy.measurement.sentry: Sentry (an American company): when an error occurs, we send its description after removing your email, your IP address, the parameters of the page address, the cookies and the connection headers. Performance traces cover 10% of visits. Session recording (Session Replay) is disabled by default.
privacy.measurement.betaProcessors: During the public beta, audience measurement and Sentry are not activated. The only service providers are: Vercel Inc. (hosting: functions run in Frankfurt, public pages distributed by its worldwide network), which adheres to the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and provides for standard contractual clauses; Neon, LLC (Databricks group, database hosted in Frankfurt), covered by the Data Privacy Framework; Upstash, Inc. (rate limiting, data in Frankfurt), under its data processing agreement — its transfer safeguards are still to be confirmed. Access from the United States cannot be ruled out. If you choose the “Map” view of the directory, your browser also loads map backgrounds from the servers of the OpenStreetMap Foundation (United Kingdom), which receive your IP address; the “List” view loads none.
privacy.measurement.transfers: Access from the United States cannot be ruled out. <0>[TO BE COMPLETED: transfer safeguards (Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses) checked for each service provider]</0> The “Map” view of the directory loads map backgrounds from the servers of the OpenStreetMap Foundation (United Kingdom), which receive your IP address; the “List” view loads none.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.contact: For any question about your data, write to: <0/>. We have not appointed a data protection officer (DPO) to date.
privacy.rights.access.title: Right of access and portability
privacy.rights.access.text: Export your data in one click from your account settings. For notes kept by an organisation: the request is reviewed by two people, an extract is provided, information about other people is hidden.
privacy.rights.erasure.title: Right to erasure
privacy.rights.erasure.text: Request deletion from your account. The request is recorded straight away, then carried out after a check by a person. Some data may be kept if the law requires it.
privacy.rights.other.title: Rectification, objection, restriction
privacy.rights.other.text: For any other request, write to <0/> or use our form. We reply within one month, which may be extended by two months if the request is complex (in that case, we let you know).
privacy.rights.cnil: If you are not satisfied with our reply, you can refer the matter to the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
privacy.cookies.noAds: No advertising and no social networks.
privacy.cookies.beta: During the public beta, no audience measurement and no error log with a service provider: details and choices on the <0>Cookies</0> page.
privacy.cookies.measured: We use audience measurement and an error log: details and choices on the <0>Cookies</0> page.
privacy.cookies.notMeasured: No audience measurement; a technical error log: details and choices on the <0>Cookies</0> page.
privacy.retention.title: Retention periods
privacy.retention.intro: What is applied automatically today (weekly purge, every Sunday at 3 a.m., UTC time):
privacy.retention.audit: Audit log (security, contains the IP address)
privacy.retention.sharedCopyDuration: when the link expires (7 days) or at most 90 days, except for retention required by law in the event of a dispute
privacy.retention.notYet: deletion of inactive accounts; retention period of the messages and documents in the Vault (kept until they or the account are deleted); follow-up files of the organisations; contact requests.
privacy.retention.deletion: To delete your account: the request is recorded straight away, then carried out after a check by a person.
privacy.never.title: What we do not do
privacy.never.sell: Sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacy.never.transmit: Pass your data on to a body (France Travail, CAF…) without your agreement, unless the law obliges us to — in that case, we check each request.
privacy.never.ai: Send your questions or your case files to an outside AI provider.
cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.seo.title: Cookies and trackers
cookies.seo.description: List of AccesDirectAide's cookies and trackers, how long they last and your choices.
cookies.intro: We use few trackers. Here is which ones, and how to make your choices.
cookies.summary.title: In brief
cookies.summary.text: Most of our trackers are used to keep you logged in, to secure the website and to keep your settings. They do not require your consent.
cookies.summary.beta: During the public beta, we do not measure the audience.
cookies.summary.notMeasured: We do not measure the audience.
cookies.summary.measured: We also measure the audience to know which pages are useful: you can object to this.
cookies.summary.noCrossSite: No tracking from one website to another.
cookies.needed.title: 1. Necessary trackers (no consent needed)
cookies.needed.intro: They are used for logging in, for security or for the display settings you asked for.
cookies.needed.sharedDevice: Shared device (library, organisation, family): your answers to the questionnaire stay on the device. Log out at the end and clear the website's data in your browser.
cookies.table.name: Name
cookies.store.session.purpose: Keep you logged in to your area
cookies.store.csrf.purpose: Protect forms against request forgery (a value drawn at random, which the website does not record and does not link to your identity)
cookies.store.banner.purpose: Remember that you closed the information banner (this is not a consent)
cookies.store.banner.duration: 6 months, then the banner is shown again
cookies.store.falc.purpose: Reading in the “easy to read and understand” version (FALC)
cookies.store.lang.purpose: The interface language you chose (or “French” if you declined the language suggestion)
cookies.store.onboarding.purpose: Stop showing the guided tour or the assistant's information
cookies.store.diagnostic.purpose: Your answers to the questionnaire, kept on the device
cookies.store.diagnostic.duration: 24 hours at most, or until you select “Start again”
cookies.store.pro.duration: Until cleared or until you log out
cookies.store.objection.purpose: Keep your objection to audience measurement (nothing is sent)
cookies.store.objection.duration: Until cleared or until the objection is withdrawn
cookies.audience.title: 2. Audience measurement and performance
cookies.audience.what: We use Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights, provided by Vercel Inc. (an American company), for our own account only: pages viewed, main actions (for example “open an information page”, “start booking an appointment”) and display speed.
cookies.audience.noCookie: According to its publisher, this solution does not place any cookie.
cookies.audience.noSearch: We do not send the text of your searches.
cookies.audience.beta: During the public beta, this measurement is not activated: no data is sent to Vercel Web Analytics or to Speed Insights.
cookies.audience.off: This measurement is not activated: no data is sent to Vercel Web Analytics or to Speed Insights. If it ever were, this page would be updated beforehand.
cookies.audience.retention: Retention period at Vercel: <0>[TO BE COMPLETED: retention period at Vercel]</0>.
cookies.audience.objection: You can object to it below, without an account: your choice is kept on this device, nothing is sent, and the measurement stops at once. You can also write to us (see the <0>privacy policy</0>).
cookies.objection.stateObjected: You have objected to audience measurement on this device.
cookies.objection.stateActive: Audience measurement is active on this device.
cookies.objection.stateOff: Audience measurement is not activated on this website. You can still record your objection on this device, for the future.
cookies.objection.stopped: Objection recorded on this device: audience measurement has stopped.
cookies.objection.notActivated: Objection recorded on this device: audience measurement will not be activated for you.
cookies.objection.failed: Your browser did not allow this choice to be kept. To object, write to us.
cookies.errors.title: 3. Technical error log
cookies.errors.sentry: When an error occurs, we send its description to our service provider Sentry (an American company), after removing your email, your IP address, the parameters of the page address, the cookies and the connection headers.
cookies.errors.replay: We do not record your sessions: session recording (Session Replay) is disabled by default. If it were ever to be activated, it would only be with your consent, and this page would be updated beforehand.
cookies.choices.title: 4. Your choices
cookies.choices.intro: You can also delete or block cookies in your browser:
cookies.choices.blocked: If you block the website's cookies and storage, you will no longer be able to log in and your display settings will not be kept.
terms.seo.title: General Terms of Use
terms.seo.description: General terms of use of the AccesDirectAide platform: rights, obligations and rules for using the service.
terms.title: General terms of use
terms.intro: Rules for using the Accès Direct Aide platform — a solidarity-based information platform.
terms.purpose.title: 1. Purpose and acceptance
terms.purpose.scope: These General Terms of Use (CGU) govern access to and use of the Accès Direct Aide platform (hereinafter “the Service”), available at <0>www.accesdirectaide.fr.
terms.purpose.acceptance: Using the Service implies full and complete acceptance of these Terms of Use. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the Service.
terms.service.title: 2. Description of the Service
terms.service.intro: Accès Direct Aide is a free information service that makes it easier to access social benefits, administrative procedures and support organisations. It is not a government service. In particular, the Service offers:
terms.service.search: A search engine for the available social benefits (national, regional, local).
terms.service.directory: A directory of local social support organisations.
terms.service.assistant: A guidance assistant (AI) to guide users towards the relevant benefits.
terms.service.pro: A professional area for social workers (management of appointments, case files).
terms.service.free: The Service is free, without advertising and without resale of data.
terms.obligations.title: 3. Obligations of the user
terms.obligations.intro: By using the Service, the user undertakes to:
terms.obligations.accurate: Provide accurate information when creating an account (user or professional area).
terms.obligations.access: Not attempt to access the systems or data of the Service without authorisation.
terms.obligations.purposes: Not use the Service for commercial, fraudulent or unlawful purposes.
terms.obligations.sensitive: Not send sensitive data (social security number, banking data) to the AI assistant.
terms.obligations.ip: Respect the intellectual property rights of the Service.
terms.liability.title: 4. Limitation of liability
terms.liability.indicative: The information presented on the platform (benefit amounts, eligibility criteria, deadlines) is provided for guidance only and comes from official public sources (government Open Data, local and regional authorities).
terms.liability.decisions: The Service in no way replaces the official decisions of the CAF, MSA, CPAM, France Travail, the Conseils Départementaux (departmental councils) or any other public body. In the event of a discrepancy, only the decisions of these bodies are authoritative.
terms.liability.assistant: The answers of the guidance assistant are generated automatically and may contain inaccuracies. They are a help with guidance, not legal or administrative advice.
terms.ip.title: 5. Intellectual property
terms.ip.owner: The source code, the visual identity, the original texts and the structure of the platform belong to the publisher of the service.
terms.ip.data: The data on social benefits comes from open public data and remains subject to the licence of each source (most often the Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0 of Etalab, as stated by the source).
terms.changes.title: 6. Changes to the Terms of Use
terms.changes.text: The publisher reserves the right to change these Terms of Use at any time. Users will be informed of any substantial change. Continuing to use the Service after a change means accepting the new terms.
terms.contact.title: 7. Contact
terms.contact.intro: For any question about these Terms of Use, you can contact us:
security.seo.title: Security and personal data (GDPR)
security.seo.description: How we protect your data. Minimal and encrypted storage.
security.title: Security and privacy
security.intro: We collect as little information about you as possible. And we protect it like a treasure.
security.pillars.encrypted.title: Encrypted data
security.pillars.encrypted.text: Messages, documents and the answers in shared case files are encrypted when stored (AES-256-GCM), in addition to the encryption in transit (HTTPS). This is not end-to-end encryption: our servers hold the keys.
security.pillars.limited.title: Limited periods
security.pillars.limited.text: Each type of data has a retention period. Some of these periods are applied automatically; the rest are awaiting a decision and the data is not yet deleted automatically. The details are in the privacy policy.
security.pillars.noSale.title: No sale
security.pillars.noSale.text: Your data is used only to help you. Never sold.
security.stored.title: What we store
security.stored.accounts: Accounts: email and password (hashed, never in plain text) of individuals and professionals; two-factor authentication codes are encrypted.
security.stored.shared: Shared case files: the answers to the questionnaire that you choose to share (encrypted) and the permissions you give.
security.stored.vault: My Vault (Mon Coffre): the documents you upload yourself (encrypted).
security.stored.log: Security log: logins and access to case files, with a fingerprint of the IP address (not the address itself).
security.stored.bookings: Appointments booked by individuals: name (encrypted) and telephone number (not encrypted) given when booking the appointment, which the organisation concerned can view.
security.notStored.title: What we do NOT store
security.notStored.medical: Your medical records (we never ask for them; upload to My Vault only what is useful for your procedure).
security.notStored.private: Information about your private life (religion, orientation, etc.).
security.purge.title: Deletion rules (purge)
security.purge.sharedCopy: Shared copy of the questionnaire: deleted when the link expires, at most 90 days.
security.purge.logs: Security logs: 365 days; proof of consent: 3 years.
security.purge.table: The full table is in the <0>privacy policy</0>.
security.rights.title: Your rights (GDPR)
security.rights.text: In accordance with the GDPR, you can ask to see, change or delete your data. To do so, use the contact form or write to <0/>.
security.technical.title: Technical details
security.technical.hosting: Hosting: Vercel, functions run in Frankfurt (EU); Vercel Inc. is an American company (see the <0>privacy policy).
security.technical.atRest: Encryption at rest: AES-256-GCM for sensitive data.
security.technical.inTransit: Encryption in transit: HTTPS (TLS) for all exchanges.
